overview: Crimson Falls is the source of Bloodfalls’ vampyric waters, corrupted by void-scar fractures and Coterie rituals.
history: Natural waterfalls were tainted when void energy seeped into the canyon.
Coterie ritualists established siphoning platforms along the falls.
Sanguine beasts mutated from prolonged exposure to corrupted waters.
Crimson mist began forming around the falls, weakening travelers.
The falls became the primary power source for Coterie operations.
hooks: Sanguine beasts swarm the canyon floor.
A void-scar fracture pulses beneath the falls.
